limits: Only the four declared absolute-path inputs were read. No linked source, identity packet, peer output, catalog, other research file, plan or repository instruction file was inspected. Read isolation was contractual rather than technically enforced.
No formula was recognized as an exact identified product; no identity search or product guessing was used.

The initial combined tool rendering truncated part of the packet and lexicon; both allowed files were rendered again completely in compact form before judging. This was an output-display limitation, not an out-of-scope access.

C03 contextual declaration retained separately: type formula_code; raw <ILN46770>; ordering not an ingredient. No independently ranked ingredient or concentration follows from it. Other records have no contextual declarations.
All four binary outputs are estimate:true and confidence:low; no sensory validation, human approval, production approval or measured cumulative build-up is claimed.

Formula-role principal/secondary/auxiliary assignments express qualitative architectural interpretation rather than concentration bands; unassessed functions remain unresolved and are not treated as negligible.

The only consumed accepted material prior is exact whole jojoba in C03 rank 3, oil-natural-build-up-v0.1 version 0.1, OE51 and the supplied scoped HW001 observation. It is a constituent clue only. Other materials, including pure marula in C04, retain their unassessed reference status.
The method v0.3 binary complete-formula rule governs these outputs; historical unknown alternatives in the material companion are not converted into product output values.
No user-fit, weight, claims, inferred percentages, concentration boundary, distribution target or external evidence was used. Low does not mean zero residue or easy washout.
Structural checks validate JSON schemas, IDs, all 84 rank/name/role copies, evidence references and opposite alternatives; they cannot validate the chemical judgments.
